summary: Completed comprehensive testing of extension error overlay suppression bug fix. PRIMARY BUG FIX VERIFIED: Extension errors (M_ID from chrome-extension) are successfully suppressed with NO overlay appearing. CRITICAL GUARD RAIL VERIFIED: Genuine app errors from our own bundle still correctly display the error overlay. All regression tests passed - no errors on any page, wall functionality works correctly, currency detection works, and frontend sends tz query param.
passed_tests: PRIMARY BUG FIX: Extension error suppression - Simulated exact user-reported M_ID error from chrome-extension 3 times, NO overlay appeared, wall remained fully visible and usable
EXTENSION PROMISE REJECTION: Simulated extension promise rejection, NO overlay appeared
CRITICAL GUARD RAIL: Genuine app errors from /static/js/bundle.js correctly display error overlay with 'Uncaught runtime errors' message (screenshot verified)
REGRESSION: All pages load without errors - /, /take, /fallen, /admin, /m/<id>, nonsense route (redirects to wall)

REGRESSION: Wall functionality - Black rail displays correctly with pattern 'HELD mm:ss · $X · PASTE OVER IT FOR $Y', held time increments over 3 seconds, takeover button navigates to /take, strip items navigate to permalinks
REGRESSION: Currency detection - GET /api/wall?tz=Asia/Kolkata returns INR with ₹ symbol, GET /api/wall?tz=America/New_York returns USD with $ symbol
REGRESSION: Frontend sends tz query param - Verified /api/wall calls include tz parameter (e.g., tz=UTC)
